title: The kb MCP coord write tools ask before they run, and a coord hook copy outside a git repository writes no store under the clone
goal: An operator decision is recorded for two points SP-xo45jvbj's review noted and BG-6jwv6ag3 left out of its repro: settings.json allows all of mcp__kb, so coord_claim, coord_release and coord_post run without a prompt; and a copy of the coord hook outside a git repository makes <clone>/kb-coord/coord.sqlite. The check reads the ask rule the recommended answer would add; a run never edits settings, so the change is the operator's (a gate). Kept from BG-6jwv6ag3's notes at the SP-4cc36epy close.

run:
import json,sys
p=json.load(open('.claude/settings.json')).get('permissions',{});ask=' '.join(p.get('ask',[]))
need=['mcp__kb__coord_claim','mcp__kb__coord_release','mcp__kb__coord_post'];miss=[n for n in need if n not in ask]
print('not asked:',miss);sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)
